data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'abbas,' meaning 'father' or 'abbot.' In Christianity, the title 'abbot' is given to the head of a monastery. The name evokes images of spiritual guidance, wisdom, and authority. The name Abate carries the meaning “Father, Abbot” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Abate usually hope their child will grow to embody father, abbot and live with faith, good character and purpose.
